punchline: The honesty-pledge result was built on rows that had been copied and tweaked.
thirty_sec: A 2012 field experiment with 13,488 insurance customers said signing an honesty promise at the top of a form raised reported mileage by 2,400 miles. In 2021 Data Colada showed the data looked fabricated: mileages spread evenly up to 50,000 and duplicated Calibri and Cambria rows. The journal retracted the paper.
question: Which figure that you quote at work have you never seen in its raw form?
key_contrast: A result everyone quoted, data nobody had checked.
